description: Weave OSv2 下一轮迭代路线图 — 深度补强与质量收敛。承接 prd-osv2-full-parity-v3.md（US-365~458 已合入）。基于 5 路并行调研，本轮关闭：ObjectSet SSE、RLS/Cell masking CEL、Audit 全覆盖、Function 版本+确定性重放、AIP Block DAG、Pipeline 增量、Parquet 冷存、GeoTemporal/TimeSeries PG 持久化、Saga 补偿策略、Funnel DLQ replay、跨对象乐观锁、TypeClass→Bleve mapping、Scenario→Aggregation 渗透、Quiver 实时数据、JWT 轮换/撤销、OIDC 安全、Tenants schema 隔离、Frontend 35 处 backend gap UI、CLI/SDK 奇偶、OpenAPI 输出、OTel 全链路、Prometheus 规范化、cookbook 全绿。60 个故事分 6 个 Phase (36~41)。详见 tasks/prd-osv2-iteration-roadmap.md。
tddConvention: Red → Green → Refactor。每个 story 先写命名 TestX_Given_State_When_Action_Then_Outcome 的失败测试（go test 表驱动 / Vitest），跑一次明确确认 fail；再写最小实现让测试转绿；再视情重构。算法/性能 story 必附 benchmark（bench/ 目录）；安全 story 必附负向测试；前端 story 必走 dev-browser skill 验证。每 story 提交前必须 go vet ./... + make test 相关包 + make web-build（若涉前端）通过。

The bench/ side gets a hard latency gate: bench/searcharound_us464_bench_test.go::TestSearchAround_ThreeHops_10K_US464_P99WithinBudget samples 25 Execute calls over a deterministic e0..e9999→d0..d199→p0..p49→c0..c4 fanout (shrinking cardinality so dedupeStrings fires each hop) and fails if P99 > 200ms — recorded P99 ≈ 3.5ms / BenchmarkSearchAround_ThreeHops_10K_US464 ≈ 3 ms/op on Apple M3 Max, leaving ~60× headroom. baseline.json untouched (the 200ms budget is the contract, not a 20% regression delta).

userStories.title: HLL / t-digest 精度可配置 + 误差基准
userStories.description: As an analyst, I want to tune approxDistinct precision and verify accuracy on 1M-cardinality data.
acceptanceCriteria: AggregationRequest 接受 hllPrecision (4-18, 默认 14) 与 tdigestCompression (默认 100)
1M 唯一值数据集：HLL p99 误差 < 2%、t-digest percentile 误差 < 1%
扫描行数阈值可配置（默认 1M）触发 APPROXIMATE 标记
userStories.notes: AggregationRequest now carries three new optional knobs — HLLPrecision (json: hllPrecision, range 4..18, default 14), TDigestCompression (json: tdigestCompression, default 100, must be positive finite), ApproximateScanThreshold (json: approximateScanThreshold, default DefaultApproximateScanThreshold=1_000_000). AggregationSpec.Compression (json: compression) is the per-spec override mirroring the existing Spec.Precision (HLL). Plumbing: new approxConfig struct created once per AggregateWithQuery via resolveApproxConfig and threaded through aggregateSimple / aggregateWithGroupBy / aggregateCubeOrRollup / recursiveGroupBy / computeMetrics; runSubAggregations propagates the three request-level knobs onto each childReq so sub-aggregations inherit. computeMetrics picks: spec.Precision > cfg.hllPrecision > DefaultHLLPrecision and spec.Compression > cfg.tdigestCompression > DefaultTDigestCompression. New helpers computeApproxPercentileTDigestC / computeApproxPercentilesTDigestC / newBoundedTDigestC keep the default-compression entry points as thin wrappers (test compatibility) while the compression-aware variants drive every production approximatePercentile call via approxPercentileFromIndex / approxPercentilesFromIndex (signature gained a compression float64 tail param). Scan-threshold logic: AggregateWithQuery computes ScannedRows ONCE post-exclusion and force-marks resp.Accuracy=APPROXIMATE when scanned > effective threshold; nil override uses DefaultApproximateScanThreshold, non-positive override disables. Validation: validateApproxConfig rejects out-of-range hllPrecision + non-positive/NaN/Inf tdigestCompression at AggregateWithQuery entry (clean 400 instead of sketch panic). Tests in pkg/oss/aggregation/us465_precision_test.go: HLL req-level + per-spec override + invalid precision rejection; t-digest req-level (compression=2 degenerate vs default=100 to prove plumbing — silently ignoring compression fails the strict-inequality check) + per-spec override + NaN/Inf/0/negative rejection; scan threshold default-not-fired-at-100-rows + threshold=50-trips-APPROXIMATE-at-100-rows + ComputeUsage.Accuracy mirror + threshold=500-stays-ACCURATE; 1M HLL p99 = 1.56% < 2% over 100 trials; 1M t-digest p99 = 0.9% (at p1) < 1% across 9 probes (p1..p99.9). CI bench gates in bench/aggregation_us465_bench_test.go: TestApproximateDistinct_OneMillion_HLL_US465_P99WithinBudget (25 seeds, p99 < 2%) + TestApproximatePercentile_OneMillion_TDigest_US465_P99WithinBudget (9 probes, p99 < 1%) + BenchmarkApproximateDistinct_OneMillion_US465_HLL + BenchmarkApproximatePercentile_OneMillion_US465_TDigest — bench/coverage_test.go untouched (US-465 not part of the 8 US-441 names; gate is the PRD accuracy budget, not nsPerOp delta). OpenAPI: AggregationRequest gained hllPrecision/tdigestCompression/approximateScanThreshold; AggregationSpec gained compression; canonical api/openapi.yaml + embedded cmd/server/openapi_spec.yaml synced byte-identical, TestContract_EmbeddedSpecMatchesCanonical/AllRoutesDocumented/NoOrphanedSpecPaths all green.

userStories.title: GeoTemporal PG 持久化
userStories.description: As an operator, I want Geo+Time queries persisted in PostgreSQL, not memory-only.
acceptanceCriteria: 时间戳 btree 索引；可选 PostGIS GIST 索引
集成测试：1M 点位空间+时间双过滤 < 100ms
userStories.notes: pkg/geotemporal/pg_store.go + migration 000205 (table + composite series-ts btree) landed in OSV2-301; US-466 hardens the spatial+temporal hot path. New migration 000208 adds (1) a standalone btree on ts for cross-series scans, (2) functional expression indexes on `(position->'coordinates'->>0)::float8` and `...->>1` so the planner can BitmapAnd a bbox predicate without parsing every JSONB payload, and (3) an optional PostGIS GIST index wrapped in a DO block that no-ops on databases without postgis (pgvector CI image has none). New geotemporal.BBox + TimeRange + SpatialTemporalQuerier interface + QueryBBoxRange method on both PgStore and MemoryStore — TimeRange.{Start,End} zero-time means "unbounded on that side"; bbox edges inclusive; positions whose JSONB isn't a GeoJSON Point are silently skipped. Integration tests in pkg/geotemporal/pg_store_spatial_test.go (build tag `integration`): index-presence inspection, mixed-points semantic, zero-time bounds, and the US-466 hard gate — 1M uniform-random points seeded via pgx CopyFrom, 25 sampled queries (random 7-day window × 20×10° bbox), P99 measured at ≈5ms vs the PRD 100ms budget (≈20× headroom); test fails if total rows over all 25 iters is zero so a degenerate seed can't silently "pass" the gate.
